title: Some entropic inequalities for primitive KMS symmetric quantum Markov semigroups
summary: In this note, we prove that every primitive KMS-symmetric quantum Markov semigroup on a finite-dimensional matrix algebra satisfies a modified logarithmic Sobolev inequality (MLSI). We also construct a primitive quantum Markov semigroup without KMS symmetry that fails MLSI, and a primitive KMS-symmetric quantum Markov semigroup that fails complete MLSI (CMLSI). The latter construction also provides a non-primitive KMS-symmetric quantum Markov semigroup without MLSI.
